payload.title: Amplify domain-association API throttling: ServiceLimitExceeded needs documented pacing and a clear failure
payload.description: Seen during Phase 6 (see the notes on PPY-7d8cd0 and PPY-52d455; AppSync 429 on new accounts is PPY-c98446): Amplify CreateDomainAssociation/UpdateDomainAssociation return ServiceLimitExceeded or throttle when several associations or apps are created in a short window. The template and docs/site-hosting.md should state the pacing (serialise associations, retry with backoff, no concurrent stack updates) and the stack should fail with a message that says to wait and retry rather than leave a half-created association. The observed limits are in the epic notes; copy them here when this is picked up.
